title: SMKConnect
subtitle: Student Job Portal
short_description: A scalable student job portal bridging vocational talent with employment opportunities.
full_description: SMKConnect is a dedicated platform designed to bridge the gap between vocational high school graduates (SMK) and companies looking for skilled entry-level talent. Features role-based dashboards for students, school administrators, and corporate recruiters.

title: Machine Request & Maintenance System
subtitle: Enterprise Asset Management
short_description: Digitizing equipment lifecycle management and breakdown reporting for operational efficiency.
full_description: Built to digitize equipment maintenance and breakdown reporting in an industrial facility. Replaced manual paper logging with automated ticket assignment, downtime metrics, and preventive maintenance scheduling.
key_features: Machine maintenance logs & historical audit trails

title: BUBURE
subtitle: Culinary Heritage Platform
short_description: A curated digital platform preserving and celebrating Indonesia's rich porridge culinary heritage.
full_description: BUBURE is an interactive cultural documentation platform celebrating traditional Indonesian porridge varieties across various provinces. Features recipe libraries, historical context, interactive ingredient maps, and community ratings.
key_features: Responsive grid layout with fluid micro-interactions
Detailed recipe steps & cultural origin narratives
Bookmark favorites stored in client storage

title: Soto Bathok Kak Roes
subtitle: Restaurant & Online Ordering
short_description: A responsive restaurant website showcasing authentic Indonesian cuisine with online ordering.
full_description: A complete digital presence for an authentic regional culinary brand. Provides online table reservations, interactive menu with dietary tags, WhatsApp order integration, and location mapping.
key_features: Mobile-first digital menu with categorized tabs
Table reservation inquiry form with validation
